Okay, I need to help the user create a LinkedIn post about joining the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee. They've worked with the standard since 2017 and are excited to contribute. Also, they want to encourage existing users to add implementations to the GitHub page and offer consulting for those not yet using it.

First, start with a catchy opening. Maybe an emoji related to health tech or committees. Then mention the new role, the years of experience since 2017, and excitement to help move the standard forward.

Next, address the community: ask implementers to add their info to the GitHub page. Make it a friendly reminder or encouragement. Then, to those not yet using CDS Hooks, offer consulting services. Highlight the benefits of the standard and position the user as available to assist.

Include relevant hashtags for visibility: #HealthTech, #CDSHooks, etc. Check for a professional tone but still approachable. Make sure links work, especially the GitHub one. Also, ensure the message flows naturally without being too long. Avoid jargon so it's accessible even to those less familiar. Maybe end with a call to action about connecting on LinkedIn or discussing further.
[/Thinking]

🌟 Exciting News! 🌟  

I’m thrilled to share that I’ve officially joined the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**! 🎉 After working with the CDS Hooks standard since 2017, I’m deeply honored to contribute to shaping its future—and even more excited to help move this transformative standard forward alongside such an incredible team.  

If your organization is already leveraging CDS Hooks: **Add your implementation** to the community map at https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability ! It’s a small step that strengthens the entire ecosystem.  

Not yet using CDS Hooks? It’s a powerful tool for enabling clinical decision support in FHIR-based workflows, and I’m here to help. Whether you’re just exploring or ready to implement, I offer freelance consulting services to guide you through every stage. Let’s connect and unlock the potential together.  

Grateful for this opportunity to give back to a standard that’s driven so much innovation in health tech. Let’s build the future of interoperable, intelligent care! 💡  

Who else is excited about the evolution of CDS Hooks? Let’s chat in the comments!  

#HealthTech #FHIR #CDSHooks #ClinicalDecisionSupport #Interoperability #DigitalHealth #Consulting #CommunityDriven #HIT 🌐  

👉 Want to learn more? Reach out directly or check out my LinkedIn profile for details on consulting services!
